address: Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane, London, England,W1J 7DR
bio: Enjoy a Parisien themed La Vie En Rose Afternoon Tea at the Michelin-starred Pavyllon London, nestled within the Four Seasons Park Lane.  Served in the elegant lounge at Pavyllon, the Afternoon Tea menu brings together nature's beauty, with picture-perfect patisserie. This unique Afternoon Tea experience fuses the traditional British Afternoon Tea with the elegance of delicate French cuisine.  Delight in elegant finger sandwiches such as the Ebi Sando with harissa & tomato, and chicken Ceaser with bacon butter. Enjoy 'So British' scones with the compote of the day, orange marmalade & vanilla cream. Head Pastry Chef Gwenael Girad has created three tiers of sweet treats including a strawberry & eucalyptus tartlet, citrus & vanilla baba and mini religieuse chocolat.  Nestled in the heart of Mayfair by Hyde Park, Pavyllon is just a short walk from Hyde Park Corner Underground Station.
